title: Rezoning map change for 69-67 108th Street, Forest Hills
summary: This resolution approves a zoning map amendment changing property at 69-67 108th Street in Forest Hills, Queens from an R1-2A district to an R7D/C2-4 district. The change would allow an 11-story mixed-use building with about 59 apartments, including 15 income-restricted units, and 3,900 square feet of commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on the proposal on September 9, 2026.
